enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Shift legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Sigh. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wipe face. Turn off light. Leave bathroom.
Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Cook eggs. Toast bread. Pour milk. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Put dishes in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out clothes. Close closet. Change into work clothes. Pack work bag. Pick up bag. Walk to living room.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and updating records
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Walk to office. Put down bag. Turn on computer. Log in. Open patient files. Walk to examination room. Greet patient. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Examine patient. Take notes. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk back to office. Update records on computer. Answer phone. Schedule appointment. Walk to waiting room. Call next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to break room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw away napkin. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties and patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to examination room. Greet patient. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Take vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Take notes. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk to office. Update records. Call patient with test results. Prescribe medication. Schedule follow-up. Walk to waiting room. Call next patient.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Park car in driveway. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to front door. Open door. Step inside. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Cut vegetables and meat. Cook meat and vegetables. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place in drying rack. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Watch TV. Change channel. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water bottle. Close refrigerator. Walk back to sofa. Sit down. Drink water. Put down water bottle. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take shower. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk to bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and phone to unwind before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Browse websites. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Read emails. Reply to email. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Lie down. Pick up phone. Scroll through phone. Put down phone. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Shift legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Sigh. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
